cohort: The study included 103 confirmed children with short stature without treatment, consecutively enrolled from a tertiary hospital.
finding: Children with functional gastrointestinal disorders (FGIDs), especially functional dyspepsia and functional constipation, exhibited significantly lower growth velocity compared to those without FGIDs.
cross-section timing: November 1 2020 to June 30 2021, and from March 1 2023 to April 30 2023
